text: サファリ　ゾーン　ないに　おちてる　どうぐは　もって　いって　いいんだよ！

structure.jp: サファリ　ゾーン　ないに　おちてる　どうぐは
structure.en: the items lying around inside the Safari Zone

structure.jp: もって　いって　いいんだよ！
structure.en: you're allowed to take with you!

patterns.name: 〜てもいい
patterns.span: もって　いって　いい
patterns.explanation: The て form plus いい means it is fine to do that. This is the casual version with も left out. もって いって いい = 'it's okay to take them away'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: サファリ　ゾーン　ないに　おちてる　どうぐ
patterns.explanation: A verb phrase placed right before a thing tells which thing is meant. サファリ ゾーン ないに おちてる どうぐ = 'items that are lying around in the Safari Zone'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている shows the state something is in after it happened. てる is the casual short form. おちてる = 'has fallen and is lying there'.
